subject: Applied Art (Commercial Art)

source.title: Fine Arts (Painting, Graphics, Sculpture, Applied Art), Codes 049-052, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

notes: Theory (History of Indian Art, 30 marks, 2 hours) is common to Painting, Graphics, Sculpture and Applied Art. The practical paper (70 marks, 6 hours) is specific to each.
Questions are set only from the artworks listed.
